label: early-stage open-source project, not an industry standard
summary: A declarative governance framework (Kubernetes-style YAML resources) in which an operator decides open questions, an orchestrator dispatches agents, and cross-harness reviewers and quality gates run before merge.
source_phases: CAPTURE · DECIDE · ADMIT · DISPATCH · REVIEW · ATTEST · MERGE

members.v21_note: Its PR approval maps to code_owner in v2.1.
members.responsibility: Resolves open questions until the Definition-of-Ready gate passes, and approves the PR before merge.

citation.section: From idea to merged PR — 2. DECIDE; 7. MERGE

members.responsibility: LLM evaluator in DoR Stage B: scores semantic gates such as whether acceptance criteria are verifiable.
Persona that enforces security and regulatory compliance: hard-mandatory gates, audit trails, provenance.

members.v21_note: spec-roles §1 maps it to supervisor; modelled here as deterministic code (flow_engine).
members.responsibility: Walks the dependency graph, admits ready work, dispatches developer subagents in worktrees and opens PRs.
Implements features with tested code; executes the pipeline's implement stage (AgentRole 'Software Engineer').

citation.section: 7. Getting Started — Step 3: Add Agent Roles

members.responsibility: Catches implementation mistakes, on a harness other than the implementer's (default: Codex).
Reviews test coverage and quality, on a harness other than the implementer's (default: Codex).
Hostile-input security analysis, on a harness independent of the implementer (default: Claude Opus).
Receives a handoff from code-agent when implementation completes; named only as a handoff target.
Checks the PR's signed attestation holds all three reviewer verdicts, approved, before allowing merge.

members.responsibility: Runs the pipeline's deploy stage, gated by a staging-verification quality gate.

members.v21_note: Governs the agent, not the artifacts; outside v2.1 scope (spec-roles §1).
members.responsibility: Approves an agent's autonomy promotions; persona that owns team delivery and quality.
